_comment: EXTERNAL ground truth, hand-checked against the live game / published stats.
This file is the real accuracy gate: it is NOT generated from the game files,
so it independently pins the ingestion chain (milli-tile units, the shared
power ladder, the rarity offset, truncation, projectile damage lookup).
Add an entry only when you have actually confirmed the number. Never
regenerate this file from a build -- that would make the gate circular.
'display_level' is the rarity-independent level the game shows (11 = tournament standard).

Knight._source: confirmed: 1,766 HP, 202 damage per hit, 168 DPS, 1.2s hit speed, 3 elixir Common

Pekka._source: 3760 HP confirmed live; damage 842 established by interaction breakpoints (see tests/test_interactions.py)

ArcherQueen._source: champion rarity offset check: base 391 at power index 0 x2.56 = 1000 at display 11

Rocket._source: well-established tournament-standard value; pins the spell projectile-damage path

Arrows._source: 122 is PER PROJECTILE. Arrows lands 3 waves of 10 projectiles 200ms apart, so a stationary target takes more than this.

Fireball._source: tournament-standard damage, 2.5-tile radius, reduced crown-tower damage

Zap._source: tournament-standard 192 damage; pins the area-effect damage path

Lightning._source: tournament-standard 1057; pins the area-effect -> projectile chain

Poison._source: tournament-standard 92 damage/second over 8s; pins the buff DoT path

IceWizard._source: tournament-standard 688 HP / 89 damage; pins the same-name character fallback

ThreeMusketeers._source: reworked card; 3 units from an explicit SummonCharactersList

engine_constants._comment: Structural facts read out of the game files and cross-checked against live play.

open_questions.question: P.E.K.K.A damage at display level 11: extracted data gives 842; some public stat sites report 510.
open_questions.resolution: 842 is correct. A same-level Musketeer has 721 HP, and P.E.K.K.A one-shotting a Musketeer is a well-established interaction that 510 cannot produce. The breakpoint also cuts the other way correctly: 842 does NOT one-shot a 1766 HP Knight, which matches play. The public 510 figure is stale. Locked in by tests/test_interactions.py.
open_questions.how_to_resolve: (kept for provenance) read Damage on the in-game card page.

open_questions.question: Arrows deals 122 per projectile across 3 waves of 10. How many waves actually land on one stationary unit, and does the in-game 'Damage' figure show per-wave or total?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Decides whether Arrows clears 230 HP Minions, which is its defining use. Affects any spell with ProjectileWaves or MultipleProjectiles (Arrows, Hunter, Princess).
open_questions.how_to_resolve: M5 models waves explicitly; then assert Arrows clears a Minion Horde and Hunter's point-blank burst kills what it should. Until then do not treat `damage` on these three as a single hit.
